name: mulassa-promo
description: Promo video capture + edit. Separate from the game: its own dependencies.

scripts.music: uv run --python 3.11 --with numpy --with scipy --with soundfile --with mido python music.py
scripts.all: npm run prep && npm run plan && npm run logo && npm run capture && npm run capture-v && npm run music && npm run render && npm run deliver && npm run render-v && npm run deliver-v
scripts.deliver: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/master-16x9.mp4 -i public/music-edit.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -maxrate 12M -bufsize 24M -profile:v high -vf scale=out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -color_range tv -af volume=-1dB -c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart -shortest out/mulassa-promo-16x9.mp4
scripts.deliver-v: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/master-9x16.mp4 -i public/music-edit.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -maxrate 12M -bufsize 24M -profile:v high -vf scale=out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -color_range tv -af volume=-1dB -c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart -shortest out/mulassa-promo-9x16.mp4
